svg.title: snug
svg.desc: The snug mark, "The Ember Niche" (variant C of TASK-20260804-logo-variants.md). The ember hex is inlined rather than currentColor because a favicon has no CSS context; e8873a is the dark theme ember, which holds contrast against both light and dark browser chrome. The niche is a true evenodd knockout, so the tab strip background shows through it. NOTE: keep XML comments out of this file, a double hyphen inside one is a parse error and silently breaks the icon.
